website.metaDescription: Nike delivers innovative products, experiences and services to inspire athletes.

checks.label: Claimed by the owner
checks.detail: The owner controls this profile, so edits from the public need approval.

checks.label: Primary category
checks.detail: The primary category is the strongest relevance signal a profile has.

checks.label: Additional categories
checks.detail: Clothing store

checks.label: Business description
checks.detail: Short descriptions under 250 characters leave out services and the areas you serve.
checks.fix: Expand the description towards 750 characters: services, specialities, and the neighbourhoods you serve.

checks.label: Phone number
checks.detail: Searchers can call straight from the listing.

checks.label: Opening hours
checks.detail: Hours are listed, so Google can show you as open.

checks.label: Address
checks.detail: A visible address helps Google and customers place the business.

checks.label: Business name
checks.detail: The name reads like a real-world business name.

checks.label: Attributes
checks.detail: Accessibility, Service options, Payments

checks.label: Average rating
checks.detail: Good, but competitors above 4.5 stand out more.
checks.fix: Reply to critical reviews and ask more of your happy customers to leave one.

checks.label: Review volume
checks.detail: At or above the 562 reviews competitors in the top results have (median).

checks.label: Reviews in the last 30 / 90 days
checks.detail: A steady flow of new reviews; the newest is from 2 days ago.

checks.label: Negative reviews (1–2★)
checks.detail: 7% of all reviews are 1 or 2 stars. Searchers read the low ratings first.
checks.fix: Find the common thread in the low ratings and fix it, reply to each one, and keep asking happy customers to review.

checks.label: Owner reply time
checks.detail: The typical reply comes long after the review, when the reviewer (and the next reader) has moved on.
checks.fix: Turn on review notifications in the Google Business Profile app and reply within 48 hours.

checks.label: Review growth vs. competitors
checks.detail: Getting new reviews at least as fast as the top competitors (median).

checks.label: Reviews mention your service
checks.detail: Few recent reviews say what the business did. Google's review topics: running shoes, staff, sizes, jordans.
checks.fix: When asking for a review, ask customers to mention the service they got (e.g. “nike store”) and the area.

checks.label: Owner responses
checks.detail: The owner replied to 14 of the latest 50 reviews.
checks.fix: Reply to every review within a few days, personally and by name.

checks.label: Low ratings answered
checks.detail: 8 of the latest 50 reviews are 3★ or lower with no reply.
checks.fix: Reply to every low rating calmly: acknowledge, explain what changed, and offer to continue offline.

checks.label: Photos
checks.detail: Plenty of photos for searchers to browse.

checks.label: Logo
checks.detail: No logo on the profile.
checks.fix: Upload a square logo.

checks.label: Cover photo
checks.detail: No main image shows at the top of the profile.
checks.fix: Choose a cover photo that shows the business at its best.

checks.label: Photos vs. competitors
checks.detail: At least as many photos as the top competitors (median).

checks.label: New photos in the last 90 days
checks.detail: Recent photos show the business is open and active.
checks.fix: Add a few new photos every month: the latest work, seasonal changes, new stock.

checks.label: Team photos
checks.detail: Faces build trust before the first call.
checks.fix: Add photos of the owner and team at work.

checks.label: Office / store photos
checks.detail: Exterior and interior photos help people find you and know what to expect.
checks.fix: Add exterior photos (from the street, with signage) and interior photos.

checks.label: Product / service photos
checks.detail: Show what customers get: the work, the products, before-and-after.
checks.fix: Add photos of your products or finished jobs, one service at a time.

checks.label: Regular photo uploads
checks.detail: Profiles that add photos steadily look cared for; one big upload years ago does not.
checks.fix: Set a monthly reminder to upload 3–5 photos.

checks.label: Video
checks.detail: A short video (30 seconds or less) of the premises or the team at work stands out on the profile.
checks.fix: Upload a short video from the Google Business Profile app.

checks.label: Website link
checks.detail: Searchers can go from the profile to your site.

checks.label: HTTPS & SSL
checks.detail: Secure, and the insecure version redirects.

checks.label: Homepage open to Google
checks.detail: The homepage loads and Google is allowed to index it.

checks.label: Website loading speed (mobile)
checks.detail: Slow on a phone (good is 2.5s or less for the main content). Visitors from Maps leave before it loads.
checks.fix: Compress and resize the largest images, defer non-essential scripts, and use caching or a CDN.

checks.label: Mobile responsive
checks.detail: The homepage adapts to phone screens.

checks.label: Homepage title tag
checks.detail: A clear title for search results.

checks.label: Homepage meta description
checks.detail: A description written for the search result.

checks.label: Broken links
checks.detail: Links that lead to error pages lose visitors and waste Google’s crawl.
checks.fix: Fix or remove the broken links listed in the Website tab.

checks.label: LocalBusiness schema
checks.detail: No LocalBusiness structured data on the homepage.
checks.fix: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the homepage with the same name, address, phone and hours as the profile.

checks.label: Service pages
checks.detail: No page found for: shoe fitting.
checks.fix: Give each main service its own page (what it is, prices or process, the area served, a call button) and link it from the menu.

checks.label: Location pages
checks.detail: No page about Portland or the areas you serve.
checks.fix: Add a page for Portland (and each nearby area you serve) with local details, directions and reviews from there.

checks.label: Trackable website link
checks.detail: Clicks from the profile show up as generic organic traffic in analytics.
checks.fix: Add UTM parameters to the website link (e.g. ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp).

checks.label: Booking & contact options
checks.detail: Searchers can call, visit the site or book straight from the profile.

checks.label: Recent Google Posts
checks.detail: Recent posts show the business is active.

checks.label: Posting frequency
checks.detail: Posts lapse after a while and an irregular profile looks unattended.
checks.fix: Plan one post a week; batch-write a month of posts at once.

checks.label: Offers & updates
checks.detail: Offers and news give searchers a reason to act now.

checks.label: Customer questions (Q&A)
checks.detail: Google removed Q&A from Business Profiles in late 2025; Maps now answers questions with AI ("Ask Maps") from the profile, the website and reviews.
checks.fix: Put the answers to common questions in the description, services, attributes and an FAQ on the website: that is what the AI answers from.

checks.label: Main keyword in the description
checks.detail: The description names the main service.

checks.label: Secondary keywords
checks.detail: The description sticks to one service, so related searches have less to match.
checks.fix: Work in related services you offer, such as “clothing store”, “sportswear store”.

checks.label: Service keyword coverage
checks.detail: Not named anywhere searchers see: shoe fitting.
checks.fix: Name every service in the description, give each its own page, and add them under Services in the profile editor.

checks.label: Category matches the keyword
checks.detail: “nike store” isn't reflected in the categories, and categories carry the most relevance weight.
checks.fix: If you offer it, choose a category that matches “nike store” (primary if it is your main service).

checks.label: Location keyword
checks.detail: “Portland” should appear in the profile description and the website title.
checks.fix: Name Portland (and the areas you serve) in the description and the homepage title.

checks.label: Competitor keyword gaps
checks.detail: Competitors use “Shoe store” (3), “Sportswear store” (3), which this profile doesn't.
checks.fix: Add the ones that describe what you do as additional categories, and cover them in the description and on the website.

checks.label: Buying-intent searches
checks.detail: In the local pack for “nike store near me”, “best nike store in portland”, “nike store portland”.

checks.label: Listed on local citation directories
checks.detail: Missing from 16 local directories. Each listing is a citation (name, address, phone) and a link Google can follow to the site.
checks.fix: Add the business to every directory marked Missing in Local citations, with exactly the same name, address and phone as the profile.

checks.label: Listed where competitors are
checks.detail: Competitors have live listings on downtownservicedirectory.com, downtownbizindex.com, citycornerdirectory.com and 8 more, where this business has none.
checks.fix: Get listed on the directories your competitors use first (marked in Local citations), with the same name, address and phone as the profile.

checks.label: Rank at the business
checks.detail: In the local pack when searched from the business’s own location.

checks.label: Top 3 across the area
checks.detail: In the local pack for “nike store” across most of the 2 × 2 km area around the business.

checks.label: Rating vs. competitors
checks.detail: At or above the average rating of the businesses ranking around you.

checks.label: Category vs. top competitors
checks.detail: 4 of the 10 businesses ranking here use “Sportswear store”, which this profile doesn't list.
checks.fix: If it describes what you do, add “Sportswear store” as a category.
